rows.label: bf04040100_0010
rows.name:
I'm sorry about earlier, about what
Hikari-chan said.

rows.label: bf04040100_0020
rows.name:
Hikari-chan came out with the sole
intention of protecting you.

rows.label: bf04040100_0030
rows.name:
She broke her own seal and even used her power
as Heaven's Holy Grail...

rows.label: bf04040100_0032
rows.name: The power I use comes from Hikari-chan's...

rows.label: bf04040100_0034
rows.name: excess energy as Heaven's Holy Grail.

rows.label: bf04040100_0040
rows.name:
Don't worry about it. It's my fault
I wasn't strong enough.

rows.label: bf04040100_0050
rows.name: More importantly...

rows.label: bf04040100_0060
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]？

rows.label: bf04040100_0070
rows.name: I'm glad you told me the truth.

rows.label: bf04040100_0080
rows.name: And thank you for protecting everyone.

rows.label: bf04040100_0090
rows.name: Protecting? Me?

rows.label: bf04040100_0100
rows.name:
Your power is amazing. It made me think
the legends really were true.

rows.label: bf04040100_0110
rows.name: I'm sorry... I...

rows.label: bf04040100_0120
rows.name: Homura, you apologize a lot, don't you?

rows.label: bf04040100_0130
rows.name: That's because of Hikari's...

rows.label: bf04040100_0135
rows.name: You're worried about the Holy Grail's power, right?

rows.label: bf04040100_0140
rows.name:
I want to become someone who makes sure
you don't have to apologize like that,

rows.label: bf04040100_0150
rows.name: or have to look sad anymore.

rows.label: bf04040100_0160
rows.name: No—I'm definitely going to become that person.

rows.label: bf04040100_0170
rows.name: Rex...

rows.label: bf04040100_0180
rows.name:
Power takes the shape
of the user's heart...

rows.label: bf04040100_0185
rows.name: That's what Vandham-san said.

rows.label: bf04040100_0190
rows.name: Your power is one that protects everyone.

rows.label: bf04040100_0195
rows.name: Everyone you protect ends up smiling.

rows.label: bf04040100_0200
rows.name:
I'm going to become the kind of Driver
who keeps Homura and everyone smiling.

rows.label: bf04040100_0210
rows.name:
A guy who makes a woman cry
is the worst kind of man.

rows.label: bf04040100_0215
rows.name:
A guy who makes a woman laugh
is the best kind of man.

rows.label: bf04040100_0220
rows.name: That's salvager motto number three, you know.

rows.label: bf04040100_0230
rows.name:
Boss! Can you help a little
with Hana's repairs, mo?

rows.label: bf04040100_0240
rows.name: Okay! I'll be right there!

rows.label: bf04040100_0250
rows.name: Oh yeah - what's for dinner tonight?

rows.label: bf04040100_0260
rows.name: How does Meatball Pot-au-Feu sound?

rows.label: bf04040100_0270
rows.name: Ooh! I'm looking forward to that!

rows.label: bf04040100_0280
rows.name:
That's Rex for you. He turns sorrow into a smile
and makes it strength for tomorrow.

rows.label: bf04040100_0290
rows.name: ...Reminds you of Adel, don't you think?
